component.name: Aura
component.summary: Animated live wallpaper manager for COSMIC Desktop

description.p: Aura is an elegant, high-performance animated live wallpaper manager built natively with Rust for the System76 COSMIC Desktop environment.
Designed to deliver immersive desktop aesthetics without compromising system efficiency, Aura integrates seamlessly into modern Wayland workflows.

ul.li: 60fps Native Performance: Built from the ground up using libcosmic and wgpu for silky-smooth rendering.
Hardware-Accelerated GPU Decoding: High-efficiency video playback keeping CPU overhead and battery drain near zero.
COSMIC Auto-Theming: Dynamically adapts UI elements and accent harmonies to system themes and wallpaper palettes.
Wayland Layer-Shell Protocol: Stutter-free wallpaper rendering docked precisely below windows across multi-monitor setups.
Intelligent Resource Throttling: Automatically pauses or throttles playback when fullscreen windows or games are active.

description.p: Aura 1.2.1 brings native 4K wallpaper quality, improved update notifications, and streamlined download flow:

ul.li: Unconstrained native 4K/UHD wallpaper rendering with high-quality spline36 and Mitchell scaling filters in mpvpaper.
High-definition Lanczos3 thumbnail generation preserving PNG and 95% JPEG quality with automatic legacy thumbnail promotion.
Reliable update notification banners when restoring Aura from the tray, dock, or D-Bus after booting in hidden mode.
Periodic background update checks and streamlined Explore download and application workflow without duplicate toasts.

description.p: Aura 1.2.0 introduces COSMIC v2 desktop accent synchronization and DenverCoder1 Minimalistic wallpapers:

ul.li: Full COSMIC Theme v2 dynamic accent color synchronization adapting system accent, button highlights (WCAG contrast), and dark/light modes to active wallpapers.
Atomic file writes triggering instant (~40ms) system-wide theme regeneration across GTK3, GTK4, Qt, and COSMIC apps.
Added DenverCoder1 Minimalistic Flat Art wallpaper collection in Explore tab with multi-category filters (Landscape, City, Nature, Anime, etc.).
High-performance parallel CDN thumbnail loading and Git LFS resilient image downloads.

description.p: Aura 1.1.4 stability, performance, and usability update:

ul.li: Fixed 0.5s playback freeze by binding mpvpaper to Wayland bottom layer, preventing cosmic-bg occlusion during dynamic theme updates.
Excluded generic Downloads and root video/pictures folders from default library scanning, preventing startup freezing.
Added solid black background for letterboxed videos, eliminating desktop wallpaper bleed-through on ultrawide monitors.
Optimized Library header button text to concise labels (Open folder / Abrir carpeta).
Fixed i18n translation for the auto-rotation toggle and status notifications.
Fixed Displays tab localization for active target button, scaling modes, and status toasts in English.

description.p: Aura 1.1.3 UI refinements and visual polish:

ul.li: Simplified About action buttons with concise labels (Github, YouTube) and uniform layout.
Removed license summary block for a cleaner, compact application details card.
Eliminated redundant icon box next to Software Updates heading.
Streamlined version status typography without emoji checkmark.

description.p: Aura 1.1.2 brings in-app updater and UI refinements:

ul.li: Integrated GUI Software Updates card in About view with instant update check, progress, and one-click atomic update and restart.
Startup background update check with non-intrusive floating action toast notification.
White monochrome symbolic icons across all external action buttons (GitHub, YouTube, Donate) conforming to COSMIC Human Interface Guidelines.
Bing wallpapers now retain human-readable titles when downloaded into Library and File Manager instead of cryptic hashes.
Automatic migration of legacy Bing wallpaper filenames to clean readable titles.
Instant thumbnail pre-linking on download eliminating frame-extraction delay.

description.p: Aura 1.1.0 brings a major feature and usability update:

ul.li: Multi-monitor support with per-output target selection and independent wallpaper playback.
Audio volume slider (0-100%) and instant mute toggle with level memory.
Floating non-intrusive Toaster notifications overlay with zero layout shift.
User-accessible wallpapers directory (saved to ~/Pictures/Wallpapers/Aura) and direct File Manager shortcuts.
Hardware decoding backend selector (auto-safe, vaapi, nvdec).
Automated playlist wallpaper rotation with custom interval and random/sequential modes.
Laptop battery saver via UPower D-Bus and non-blocking Feral GameMode pausing.
In-app update checking and update CLI command.
Enhanced Flatpak sandbox permissions for audio, system bus, and COSMIC theming.

description.p: First official production release on Flathub and COSMIC Store. Features animated live wallpaper playback at 60 FPS, online 4K catalogs (Bing UHD and Wallhaven), COSMIC auto-theming, smart library filters, and Wayland power optimizations.

Aura 0.2.0 introduces online 4K wallpaper catalogs (Bing UHD and Wallhaven), smart library filters (Live, Static, Downloaded), deletion management from UI, CPU optimizations for static images, native Wayland auto-pause, and standard CLI flags.
Initial release of Aura live wallpaper manager for COSMIC Desktop.
